d:
Bihar men apne sanbodhan ke dauran pradhanmantri Narendra Modi ne Nitish Kumar ka jikr karte hue kaha, 'nitish ji ke aashirvad se...' aakhir PM Modi ne manch se aage kya kaha aur Nitish Kumar ko lekar apne sanbodhan men kya sandesh diya? dekhie unka pura bayana.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
